svg.text: Direction A is the approved production palette; the former green control remains below for comparison.
Warm white coat/apron field with a muted steel undershirt. Strongest kitchen read; still QuotaCo clinical.
Conventional institutional service uniform. Clear and restrained, but keeps more dark mass at gameplay scale.
Warmer cafeteria identity with a cream apron and QuotaCo rust undershirt. Friendlier, less sterile.
